title: The vendor Credit Terms dropdown lists active terms, with no Default tag
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 10 days after the invoice date, is the default for new customers. Its own term B, due on day 5 of the following month, is active. Net 50 is deactivated and every other standard term is active. Other shop terms (from other tests) may also be offered.
  • Start on Parts, Vendors.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Vendor" window opens.

Step 2:

  • It lists the active terms in the page order: COD first, Due on Receipt second, then the Net terms by days with term A after Net 7 and before Net 15, then Net 15 to Net 120 (Net 50 missing), then the day-of-the-following-month terms with term B among them, and Credit Hold last.
  • No item carries a "Default" tag (not even term A).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R1: “The Credit Terms dropdown on New Vendor and Edit Vendor lists the shop's active terms, standard and its own, in the S1-R5 order.”
  • S6-R2: “New Vendor starts on COD, as today. The shop's default does not apply to vendors, and the vendor dropdown shows no "Default" tag.”
  • S6-N2: “Inactive terms are never offered to a vendor not already on them.”
  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”
  • Key Decisions: “One default and one term list per organization, shared by customers and vendors.”
  • Feature Overview: “Customers and vendors share one term list. The shop's default applies to new customers only; new vendors keep starting on COD.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "7 Vendors" ("New Vendor: starts on COD, picker with your terms", "Edit Vendor: the picker with your terms").
